_about: Section words for the Google News query (agent test, 2026-09-27, ~67 test requests). Query = when:90d <hint or "name"> <words>. 'words' is the exact bracketed text to append. Tested: the words cut junk for confusing names but also drop some real articles for well-known names (see report).
